notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 Released!
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.6 is now available, here are the patch notes:

- Escape key can now be used to exit examining notes and items
- Added new audio effects to certain parts of the game
- Updated some old sounds
- Fixed a small collision issue

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 Released!
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.5 is released, fixing the following:

- Updated flashlight, now much smoother while following camera
- Updated player death animations, interactions with creatures more polished
- Note in Chamber no longer sideways while zoomed in
- Boarded up doorways will now correctly save/load if they are broken or not
- Note in Office should no longer fall through desk
- Polished a few environments
- Ending sequence now has correct collisions in order to get through unwanted areas
- Updated the summary on a few of the notes
- Fixed bug where flashlight would occasionally spin behind player
- Fixed bug where creature animations occasionally wouldn't play correctly
- Slightly smoother performance in most areas

Our list of reported bugs is almost complete! Only a few minor inconsistencies remain. We are currently working on our next patch, which will be focused on polishing up the game!  If you have found a bug, you can contact us at Sillypillstudios@gmail.com.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 Released!
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.4 is released, fixing the following:

- Fixed a bug where the stones in the maze section would have stretched models
- Fixed a bug where loading from inside the cave could occasionally cause the player to be trapped
- Fixed a few tiny areas in which ambient outside sound would sound as if you were outside when player was inside
- Updated collision in certain areas 

You can confirm the update is downloaded in the Main Menu, at the bottom right it will say the Version number.

We are currently working on patch 1.0.5, which will be out very soon! If you have found a bug, you can contact us at Sillypillstudios@gmail.com.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 Released!
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.3 is now released, by fixing the following:

- Note for clues for the safe code is now in the same order as code to prevent confusion
- Rock geometry through floor cleaned up
- Floating objects in specific area removed
- Collision in certain areas improved
- Small performance boost, all users should notice slight fps increase

You can confirm the update is downloaded in the Main Menu, at the bottom right it will say the Version number.

We are currently working on patch 1.0.4, which should be out tomorrow! If you have found a bug, you can contact us at Sillypillstudios@gmail.com.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 Released!
notes.content:
1.0.2 is now released, fixing many bugs:

- Notes will now correctly show both sides of the paper
- Door to maid's room now correctly shuts 
- Small performance boost, most users should notice slight fps increase
- Mouse Sensitivity now correctly works
- Mouse axis options added
- Base brightness to lighting slightly increased, slightly less dark in all areas 
- Options menu (Escape key), can no longer be opened while the inventory is open or while examining an object
- Other small fixes

You can confirm the update is downloaded in the Main Menu, at the bottom right it will say the Version number.

We will continue to be on the look out for any more bugs, so we can fix them as quickly as possible! If you have found a bug, you can contact us at Sillypillstudios@gmail.com.
